messages.subject: DesignSampleSize
parts:
Dear Developers,
We are currently wondering what the output of the designSampleSize() function means precisely.

How do I have to understand the CV column to be precise? and is FC a log2FC ?

I would greatly appreciate any help :)

Best, Klemens

messages.author: 0f36a4d38f68e366
messages.subject: Re: DesignSampleSize
parts: CV = Standard error/ desired fold change (desiredFC). The standard error is determined based on the minimal sample size (numSample). desiredFC is on the original scale, so it is bigger than 1.
